meta.note: avg per-frame mIoU on this specific 100-frame window is 0.558, notably below the checkpoint's held-out validation mIoU (see 'checkpoint' above) -- this window uses uniform random downsampling at inference (inference.classify() has no ground truth to do class-aware sampling with, unlike train.py's validation), which under-represents rare classes like static_obstacle_pole/dynamic_pedestrian more than the reported validation number does. For the pitch, cite the held-out validation mIoU as the model's real accuracy figure, not this demo clip's average.
